newsitem.title: USA: NY judge declines comment on Startronix.
newsitem.headline: NY judge declines comment on Startronix.

text.p: A New York Supreme Court Justice declined to comment on Friday about a report that a temporary restraining order had been issued to freeze Startronix Corp's bank account.
Startronix's placement agent said on Friday the judge had signed a temporary restraining order freezing Startronix's bank accounts.

The agent said it took legal action against the company because Startronix refused without a valid and recognizable reason when investors in the company's recent private placement submitted their preferred shares for conversion into common stock.
Startronix said it suspended the conversion of its Series C preferred shares because of market irregularities in trading of its outstanding common stock.
